title: PointToPointBid
description: A priced point-to-point spread bid (e.g. an up-to-congestion or PTP obligation bid): a willingness-to-pay curve on the price spread between two locations. Clears as a withdrawal at the source terminal and an injection at the sink terminal.

id.description: Unique integer identifier for this component.

name.description: Name of the component. Components of the same type (e.g., `PowerLoad`) must have unique names, but components of different types (e.g., `PowerLoad` and `ACBus`) can have the same name.

available.description: Indicator of whether the bid is available for market clearing (`true`) or not (`false`).

from_id.description: ID of the source terminal (withdrawal side), resolved through the entity registry: a topology record or a trading hub.

to_id.description: ID of the sink terminal (injection side), resolved through the entity registry: a topology record or a trading hub; must differ from `from_id`.

max_active_power.description: MW envelope for the bid. Units: MW.

spread_bid.description: Willingness-to-pay curve on the to-minus-from price spread, as an offer-curve operating cost (incremental side only).

price_limits.description: Tariff bid-price bounds on the spread. Units: USD/MWh.

linked_crr.description: Identifier of a linked congestion-right instrument, when the market couples the bid to one.
